verdict.rationale: Intel's own developer docs explicitly cite oneAPI/oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations for Core Ultra processors series 2 (which includes the 258V) and Arc GPUs, and general AI-PC docs describe CPU/GPU/NPU engines working together for AI software — satisfying the 'vendor's own AI software stack' clause of the story. However, there is no mention of llama.cpp, MLX, or ONNX Runtime specifically targeting this chip, nor any OpenVINO/NPU-specific runtime documentation or independent benchmarks confirming real-world support. Missing for 10: explicit llama.cpp/MLX/ONNX Runtime support statements, NPU-targeted runtime docs (e.g., OpenVINO), and independent/community corroboration of actual inference on this SKU.
